dialogues.speaker: Munaciello
dialogues.text: I transport information from one place to another, just like how sailors carry goods.

dialogues.speaker: Munaciello
dialogues.text: Information's like futures — no capital, no profit.

dialogues.speaker: Munaciello
dialogues.text: And trust me, I've got capital to spare — Munaciello the "Porter" won't run low on cargo to transport, believe you me.
